correctness.rationale: From the fourteen coordinates all 91 pairwise squared distances have shells 3:24,4:12,8:24,11:24,12:4,16:3. Below sqrt3 the complex is discrete; at sqrt3 a connected 14-vertex/24-edge bipartite graph has first Betti 11. At r=2 the maximal triangles triangulate the twelve rhombic facets of the convex dodecahedral boundary, giving S2. At squared scale 8 the cube-induced subcomplex is the join of four antipodal 0-spheres, hence S3. For each nonempty compatible axis subset, its cube neighbors form a simplex; pairing each axis-containing face according to a distinguished compatible cube vertex gives acyclic relative matching; an explicit independently found sequence of 80 elementary free-face deletions confirms a genuine collapse to the cube S3 (not merely Betti agreement). At squared 11 all and only the seven antipodal pairs are forbidden so (S0)^*7=S6, while at squared 12 every cube vertex spans a simplex join factor and the complex contracts despite three absent axis-antipodal edges; sqrt16 adds no homology. Each positive homology degree appears in one interval only. G=signed permutations acts on S2 with determinant, on cube S3 with sign of permutation of four antipodal body diagonals, and on S6 via product; H1 of the graph has trace 1+pointwise-fixed-edges-fixed-vertices. Independently enumerated all thresholds with clique face totals 38,74,240,2186,6911,16383 and checked 80 sequential free-face collapses, complementing source certificate. No unsupported inference from finite samples: object itself is finite and geometric identifications prove integral types.
residual_risks: The argument establishing integral H3 relies on full simple-homotopy collapse, not merely verified Euler characteristics.
Character formulas for group actions are integral sign modules in higher degrees; graph-stage character is only rational trace.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge new exact Euclidean fourteen-point Rips filtration and its full octahedral characters. Saleh–Titz Mite–Witzel work classifies Platonic vertex sets, notably a dodecahedron with 20 vertices; the rhombic dodecahedron is a distinct 14-vertex Catalan solid. The earlier Resultary cuboctahedron computation involves its 12 vertices (dual polytope, not equal Euclidean metric on fourteen rhombic vertices), different critical shells. General antipodal-pair joins cover S6-like endpoints, but not the scale sqrt8 all-vertex collapse or complete characters.
